moves: tangrowth is a criminally underrated wall. It counters so much with a mono grass typing, its scary. It serves as a reliable ground resist, and counters lots of offensive threats like ash Gren, Koko, mega Gyarados, Latios, and Kingdra. Basically a god send for my team.

hippo is the heart of my team. Simply put. This mon checks almost all physical threats in the tier, such as mega pinsir, zard x,lando, mega metagross, etc and also is a hard stop to koko (if it happens to have brave bird instead of grass knot.) I decided to add toxic instead of roar because I can worn down lando turn 1, which both mega chomp and Excadrill appreciate.

excadrill is the perfect sand mon. it does so much, such as being one of the most fearsome late game sweepers, being also a amazing wallbreaker, and on the top of it, it has a blazing 500 speed under sand, making it a complete offensive mon.

if excadrill is the complete offensive mon, then toxapex is the complete support mon. it has a amazing typing, access to hazards, defeats basically almost all setup mons with haze, and has both regen and reliable recovery.

Mega chomp is a amazing wallbreaker under sand. Nothing switches in fire/ground/grass. You basically have to either: have fully phydef skarm on your team, or just sack something when against this monster of a mon.
